_README: INDIA parameter file (steltic_nonlinear_india, NL-6). Every entry is either an IS value (with its clause) or a labelled
MODELLING ASSUMPTION. Owner rulings D3/D6/D7: no foreign design basis, no ASCE 41 / AISC 342 acceptance, results informative.
Steel strength: the analyses take fy per member from the HR package (IS 2062 (Part 1):2025 Table 3 by thickness band; IS 1161
Table 2 for tubes) -- `material` below is only the fallback for a member the package does not describe. `snl collect` reads
the IS values out of the corpus and writes the job's hinge_params_collected.json from this template.
Hinge backbones (beam_flexure, column_flexure, brace_axial) are modelling assumptions: IS 800:2007, IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 and
IS 18168:2023 tabulate none (nlrha.india_authority.hinge_analogue_status: found:false). The India NSP / NLRHA use FIBRE plasticity
(forceBeamColumn); the backbone numbers below shape only the corotTruss brace envelope and the force-controlled column flag.
There are no IO / LS / CP acceptance values in this file: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 provides no acceptance criteria for nonlinear
analysis; results are for information. IS 800 Section 12 joint rotations (0.02 / 0.04 rad) are shown as REFERENCE only.
source: IS values: IS 2062 (Part 1):2025 Table 3 (fy fallback), IS 800:2007 Table 5 / 7.1.2.1 (brace strength curve), IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 7.2.4 (5 % reference). Backbone shapes: modelling assumptions (literature forms), not IS values.

material.source: IS 2062 (Part 1):2025 Table 3, E 250, ReH t <= 16 mm = 250 MPa (fallback only; per-member fy comes from the HR package)
material.Ry_basis: expected-strength factor 1.0 = nominal. IS 800:2007 has no expected-strength factor; IS 18168:2023 Table 1 Ry is a capacity-design factor, reported as reference, not applied. EOR input: nl_plan.material.expected_strength_factor.

beam_flexure.basis: MODELLING ASSUMPTION (not an IS value): backbone shape of a concentrated-plasticity beam hinge, used only on the non-India IMK path; India runs fibre plasticity

column_flexure.basis: MODELLING ASSUMPTION (not an IS value): used on the India fibre path only to FLAG columns whose gravity axial ratio PG/Pye exceeds force_controlled_above_P_over_Pye (information)

brace_axial.basis: corotTruss brace. STRENGTHS are IS values: tension Pye = A fy, buckling Pcr = A chi fy on the IS 800:2007 7.1.2.1 curve (Table 10 class, Table 7 alpha), fy from the HR package, no partial factor (model strength). The post-buckling / post-yield deformation multiples (a, b, c) are MODELLING ASSUMPTIONS (literature form; IS gives no brace hysteresis model).
brace_axial.K_basis: modelling assumption: pin-ended brace, K = 1.0 on the full node-to-node length (the HR design may use per-axis K; the NL keeps the member length)

compression.note: modelling assumption: linear interpolation between the stocky and slender limits on KL/r

tension.note: modelling assumption: 10 % strain hardening over a; residual 0.8 Pye to b

brace_axial.element: corotTruss + Hysteretic (no pinching, no cyclic damage)

gravity_for_pushover.expr: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 7.3 / 7.4 seismic weight W_i per level (full dead load + Table 10 imposed share; 7.3.2 roof imposed load not considered) -- the HR engine's W
gravity_for_pushover.note: applied as equal shares on the level's diaphragm nodes (pushover.india_model.is_gravity_loads); mass = W_i / g on the diaphragm master (D6). No ASCE 41 1.1(QD + 0.25 QL).

nsp.method: target displacement by the displacement-coefficient method (ASCE 41 Eq. 7-28 form) -- IS 1893 has no nonlinear static procedure; the method is used as a modelling tool and its output is information (D7)
nsp.load_pattern: first translational mode of the push direction x mass (the mode the modal pattern selector names)
nsp.C1_a_basis: C1 'a' is keyed to ASCE site classes, which have no IS 1893 soil-type mapping: EOR input nsp.C1_a_eor, else 60 (the most conservative tabulated value), disclosed in the output
nsp.Cm_basis: method input (ASCE 41 Table 7-4 form), not an IS value
nsp.note: Sa(Te) from the IS 1893 elastic spectrum: DBE = (Z/2)·I·Sa/g, MCE = Z·I·Sa/g, never divided by R (D6).

damping.basis: NLRHA inherent viscous damping (Rayleigh at T1 and 0.2 T1, stiffness part on the frame elements only). IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 7.2.4 prescribes 5 % for estimating Ah (the elastic spectrum the records are scaled to is 5 %-damped); with fibre hysteresis modelled explicitly, the model's viscous part is a modelling assumption (default 2.5 %), EOR input nl_plan.damping.xi, never above the 7.2.4 value without an EOR record.

numerics.note: post_cap_ratio = fraction of the capping rotation a over which strength descends from Mc to c*My (0.15 ~ ASCE 41 vertical drop). Raising it to capture the descending branch is a modelling change: only with the user's consent, and it is disclosed in the report. tail_strategies is the solver escalation ladder tried automatically when the push stops before 0.8*Vmax. Default plasticity=fibre (forceBeamColumn + Lobatto); member_nseg=4 matches MC4 fibre suite. Use imk for concentrated ModIMK / L2 FBC path. Product NLRHA starts ModIMK (imk) then PZ×1 then fibre+mesh; ConcentratedPlasticity auto-ladder (L1/L2/L3) is NOT a product default. NSP/HR DDM remain fibre. PZ default rigid.

panel_zones.note: rigid panel zones (fibre path); scissors springs are a USA-scaffolding option
